title: One-tap visual judgment contract
description: Disposable authenticated loopback gateway. Confirms without prose, reads back the qualified receipt and derived claim, rejects an empty Issue, and preserves the gate. No production run is touched.

rpc.intent: Exercise the public visual-review RPC and integrity/delegation/refresh controls.

verified.contains: authenticated public RPC records a text-free confirmation and refuses an empty Issue
verified.intent: The real authenticated endpoint and state readback passed.

feedback-regression.intent: Verify that stale-snapshot refusals remain visible outside collapsed package details.

feedback-verified.intent: Require the publication-action visibility regression to pass.

package-build.intent: Build the shared gate package with its declared SDK dependency.

package-built.intent: Require the shared package build to succeed.

native-result.intent: Use an isolated authenticated gateway and a real provider to inspect red and green squares and return exact schema-bound completed-command results.

native-result-verified.intent: Require actual native visual inspection and clean process teardown; contract fixtures alone cannot satisfy this proof.

mixed-regressions.intent: Check the cancellation, restart, WARM lineage and frozen-person-precedence regressions alongside the public transport proof.

mixed-regressions-verified.intent: Require the migration regressions, including controls known to fail with the old branches.

policy-default.intent: Require visual ACs to accept qualified pipeline receipts without project setup, reject removed person-only configuration and use the shared unchecked label.

policy-default-verified.intent: Require the default verification, precedence and no-policy regression checks to pass.
